description: r5r provides an R interface to the R5 engine for multimodal routing, detailed itineraries and travel-time and monetary-cost matrices. The provider is Ipea and collaborators. Geographical and temporal coverage: The software applies to user-defined walking, cycling, transit and car networks; it has no fixed observation period. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): MIT. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: r5r and Conveyal's R5 engine have independent release cycles, so version compatibility must be checked. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
